loading_tips: Rowhouse stoops make great cover. Neighbors less so.
The water taxi runs late. Your getaway should not.
Duck into an alley to shake a two-star heat level.
Pigeons scatter when trouble is close. Watch the sky.
Market vendors pay cash for errands. Ask around.
Drive slow past the harbor cops and they barely look.
Rain makes the cobblestones slick. Brake early.
Painted screens hide a lot. Peek before you knock.
Corner stores restock at dawn. So do the bosses.
A full tank and a clean record never hurt anybody.
Hold the drone steady for sharper photo mode shots.
The light rail is free if nobody checks. They check.
Bosses telegraph big swings. Sidestep, then punish.
Lost? The harbor is always downhill from here.
Save often. The city does not hold grudges, you do.
tutorial_tips: Tap jump twice to vault a short fence.
Hold sprint to run. Let go to catch your breath.
Press interact near a door to go inside.
Swipe left or right to dodge an attack.
Open the map to set a waypoint.
Green arrows mark your next mission stop.
Lose the heat meter by hiding out of sight.
Tap a vendor to see what they will trade.
Hop on a water taxi to cross the harbor fast.
Pick up snacks to refill your health bar.
Pause anytime to check your goals.
Photo mode lives in the pause menu.
achievement_descriptions: Visit every water taxi dock in one day.
Spend coins at every single market stall.
Scatter a flock of 50 pigeons at once.
Finish a mission between midnight and dawn.
Win the wing eat-off on any difficulty.
Last three full rounds in the octagon.
Unlock every safe house in the city.
Finish a mission during a rainstorm.
Fill up at every gas station on the map.
Ride the light rail from end to end.
Beat the final boss and save the city.
crime_meter_clear_messages: All clear. Nobody saw a thing.
Cops gave up. Grab a snack.
Clean slate. Try to keep it.
Street is quiet again. For now.
